scenarios.name: Baseline conditions
scenarios.description: Light rain and a normal river stage. Used as the deterministic reset state.

scenarios.name: Heavy rainfall, rising water
scenarios.description: Intense rain that is still increasing and a high river stage. Low-lying roads become unsafe and a shelter is lost to flooding.

scenarios.name: Critical road closure
scenarios.description: Moderate rain with Street E (1-2) closed near the demo origin, forcing a longer route to a different shelter.
